description: This PHP source file defines the class IoTWirelessClient, which serves as a client interface for interacting with the AWS IoT Wireless service. It includes method annotations for various API operations related to wireless devices, gateways, multicast groups, and other resources in the service.

classes.name: IoTWirelessClient
classes.description: A client class used to interact with the AWS IoT Wireless service, extending the generic AwsClient to include specific methods for this service.

methods.name: associateAwsAccountWithPartnerAccount
methods.description: Associates an AWS account with a partner account.

methods.name: associateMulticastGroupWithFuotaTask
methods.description: Associates a multicast group with a FUOTA (Firmware updates over the air) task.

methods.name: createWirelessDevice
methods.description: Creates a new wireless device resource.

methods.name: getWirelessDevice
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specific wireless device.
